title: ConvRulesEditor
summary: Visual rulebook editor for the conversion rules; its Convert tab reports StripDB value casts, cast sites to convert by hand and uses changes (engine 1.27)
intro: Edit conversion-rules books visually, run a conversion and see what is left to do by hand.

surfaces.name: ConvRulesEditor.exe
surfaces.menu: Conversion > Convert... (the IDE plugin starts it with --convert-request FILE and probes --write-capabilities FILE)

questions.ask: How do I edit a conversion-rules book without a text editor?
How do I see what a conversion would change before running it?
questions.command: Open the Convert tab in ConvRulesEditor.exe (see the manual, section Composing the rules for one job)

questions.ask: Can the Convert tab convert many units faster, and how do I turn that off?
questions.command: Batch mode is automatic for 2+ units on an engine with batch_units (one convert-apply per book per 8 units); set CONVRULES_BATCH=off before starting ConvRulesEditor.exe to convert one unit at a time

questions.ask: Why does Convert reorder my units, or refuse because of an ancestor?
questions.command: Inherited units always convert after their ancestors (C8CHAIN): adding a unit offers every ancestor that still holds a From type, root first, and Convert asks to reorder the list ancestor-first (No runs nothing). An unconverted ancestor that is not in the run blocks too: Yes adds the missing ancestors root-first and runs, No cancels the whole run. An ancestor class found in neither the project index nor the platform library index blocks the run: add its unit to the .dproj/.dpr and reindex. A class declared in more than one project unit is ambiguous and blocks with its own message: remove the duplicate or qualify the class. When the platform library cannot be asked, only TForm, TFrame, TDataModule and their TCustom* forms still count as library roots
